places.about: pipeline/find.mjs: Text Search (New) only, list price per 1,000 requests at the fields we ask for (check Google price list). 3,600 requests is about $126 at list price: the budget for 180 emails a day (Alon, 2026-11-27), before Google's free monthly allowance.

sending.about: pipeline/queue.mjs plans each day's emails for approval; pipeline/send.mjs sends an approved list. Per mailbox: start = the date of its first cold email (until set, it sends nothing); daily = {first, step}: first emails on the start day, +step every day after (weekends too) (Instantly's ramp: start small, +2 a day); max = hard ceiling: 30 a mailbox (Alon, 2026-11-27: 6 x 30 = 180 a day). Never a neonsignsites.com address.

wording.about: pipeline/cli.mjs: once a trade's wording library (wording/<trade>.json) has this many reviewed previews, the headline, titles and steps come from it as is, and the AI is asked only for the business's facts and photos.
